elements.description: Publishes its input to a lossless network stream.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Pins the stream's type (otherwise inferred)

parameters.name: stream_id
parameters.description: Stream UUID; the same on both ends

parameters.name: max_elements_per_packet
parameters.description: Batch size

parameters.name: max_batch_latency_ms
parameters.description: Longest wait before a partial batch is sent

parameters.name: send_log_max_packets
parameters.description: Unacknowledged packets kept for replay

parameters.name: max_block_ms
parameters.description: Longest publish wait on a full send log before the stream faults

parameters.name: max_wait_ms
parameters.description: Longest receive wait for data before the stream faults (underrun)

parameters.name: producer_node
parameters.description: Node UUID allowed to produce the stream (NetSource; empty: any)

parameters.name: consumer_nodes
parameters.description: Node UUIDs allowed to consume the stream (NetSink; empty: any)

parameters.name: max_latency_ms
parameters.description: NetSource: packets arriving later than this (end to end, synchronized clocks) are counted LATE

parameters.name: sample_rate
parameters.description: Two positive integers [numerator, denominator] in elements/second, e.g. [1000,1]. Uniform rate permits derived timestamps; omitted means no uniform-rate declaration. Does not resample signals.

parameters.name: timestamps
parameters.description: Array of distinct string roles MODEL_TIME, SOURCE_TIME, PROCESSING_TIME, e.g. ["MODEL_TIME"]. Omitted means no timestamp roles. Without sample_rate, timestamps for declared roles travel with packets; a role declaration does not create a timestamp source.

elements.description: Publishes one simultaneous channel frame per graph step. Raw or independent lossless LZ4/Zstandard transport. Channel types, order, rate and encoding must match both ends. A failed graph sample latches the boundary; restart with a new stream UUID. Model-time grid only; hardware audio devices and automatic cross-node frame routing are separate integrations.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Channel value type; inferred from all connected channels

parameters.name: stream_id
parameters.description: UUID shared by both ends. Use a new UUID after a fault or any descriptor change.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.description: Ordered unique channel names, 1–64. Each graph step transfers one value on every channel.

parameters.name: frame_rate
parameters.description: Exact logical frames/second as [numerator, denominator]. Packet size never changes this rate.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: Independent lossless blocks; both ends must select the same encoding. Missing codec support is an error.

parameters.name: max_frames_per_packet
parameters.description: Maximum frames per packet; numeric payload must fit 256 KiB.

parameters.name: window_packets
parameters.description: Bounded replay/receive packet window; pools reserve worst-case payload capacity.

parameters.name: max_batch_latency_ms
parameters.description: Flush a partial packet after this interval; this is transport batching, not model time.

parameters.name: max_block_ms
parameters.description: Maximum wait for publish capacity; failure latches the boundary.

parameters.name: max_wait_ms
parameters.description: Maximum wait for a complete input frame; never invents missing values.

parameters.name: producer_node
parameters.description: Expected producer node UUID; transport enforces this peer restriction.

parameters.name: consumer_nodes
parameters.description: Allowed consumer node UUIDs; transport enforces these peer restrictions.
